'''Egalla Rennta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] employee of [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She served as the company's [[NewsNet]] liaison.
